fichas.title: Sheep Housing: Layout and Building Design
fichas.summary: Guidance for sheep-shed orientation, seasonal and age/sex-based grouping, feeding arrangements, and building construction. The page illustrates sheds with and without transverse gangways, a silo and feed-mixing area, and a large shed plan. It specifies floor and threshold levels, building height, door size, and protective construction details. Window area and feed-mixing area are given as ratios in the text.
uses: House sheep in groups organized by age and sex
Provide flexible housing for seasonal changes and lambing

fichas.title: Sheep Housing: Space and Feeding Requirements
fichas.summary: Tabulated loose and lying area and necessary feeding width by animal category, plus net space requirements for sheep kept in a herd on a fully perforated floor. The page also gives optimal shed climate values and fodder-storage space requirements. Values and ranges are transcribed from the printed tables.
uses: Determine space provision by sheep category
Plan herd housing on fully perforated floors

fichas.title: Sheep Housing: Fences, Animal Dimensions, and Shed Climate
fichas.summary: The sheet includes sheep body dimensions, fence details, breed weights and body measurements, and optimal climate values for sheep sheds. Fence drawings include a dividing fence made from roofing battens, an alternative with wire mesh, and an extendable batten fence.
uses: Reference sheep body size and shed climate
